extra_quotes: CIPS flakes are mechanically exfoliated from the bulk crystals (Supplemental Materials) and transferred onto the target substrates (e.g., SiO 2/Si, gold, and PZT).
Next, we investigate the SHG responses in CIPS using a home-made nonlinear optical microscope (Supplemental Materials ).
We deposit epitaxial 50 nm (001) PZT thin film on 10 nm La 0.67Sr0.33MnO3 (LSMO) buffered SrTiO 3 (STO) substrate (step 1).
Circular domain patterns are then written on the PZT film via conductive AFM tip (step 2).
For thinner CIPS flakes with diminishing SHG signal, the polar axis cannot be determined prior to transfer.
